errors.password: Password too short (10 characters minimum) or too common.

setupHint: No account exists yet: create the one that will be able to invite the others. The setup code is shown in the API log (docker compose logs api) or set by SETUP_TOKEN.
resetUntil: Single-use link, valid until {{time}}. It replaces the previous one.
teamLink: Invitation link (creates an account in the team)
teamTransferAsk: Hand the team ownership to {{name}}? You stay a member.
teamDissolveAsk: Disband the team? Everyone leaves it (each player keeps their own marks).
deleteWarning: Your account and all your progress (marked items, filters) will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
passkeyHint: A passkey signs you in with your device's fingerprint, face or code, without a password. Your password still works.
legend_mine: Me and part of the team
adminDeleteHint: Their account and all their progress are permanently deleted; they leave their team.
adminDeleteAsk: Permanently delete the account “{{name}}” and all its progress?
